privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: Measure friction: behaviour checks in 2 or 3 representative repositories plus the friction logs
goal: A before-evidence of how often agents slip, with the number of runs used
acceptance: the agent-behaviour checks (`npm run behaviour -- run`, Claude Code runner, `--set=drafting`) run in 2 or 3 representative repositories (suggested: project-harness, nerv, coordinator); the report states the runs used per repository (bounded: scenarios x `behaviour.times`, each run costs agent time) and each scenario's pass count against its last run

the friction logs (`node tools/friction.mjs report`) and the 2026-11-26 slips (a silently forked copied harness file, a reversed battery-core wording, a skipped failing-first test, an edit in NERV's primary checkout) are read; each slip is matched to a scenario that covers it or listed as a candidate new scenario (a proposal to project-harness: the coordinator edits no harness file)
written to docs/reviews/2026-11-coherence/friction.md; a scenario failing now becomes a B- record in its repository through the owner

effort.basis: 3 repositories at about 0.75 h of runner waiting (background) plus 0.75 h reading logs and slips. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed for coordinator-only work. Not a measurement.
